_what: Your tray (src/workspace/tray.ts, tray-screen.tsx): what a person picks anywhere in Trillion, and what they can do with it. `pick` is what counts as a thing on the page, nearest first (parts/ui/show/selection/pick-things.ts): a selector, the kind of thing it is in plain words, its icon, the attribute holding its identity and whether it is named by its screen. `ignore` is the tray's own controls, never picked. Where the tray can go is the places a person shares to (src/share-destinations.mjs), tool places among them: every tool whose input takes what is shared is one, so a new place is a tool row. `picture_folder` is where a picture of the screen is kept in their Files. `menu` is what the right-click menu adds. Every word here is what the person reads; `composer` is laid over the shared composer's own words (parts/ui/show/composer/composer-words.json) for the note box at the tray's foot. `control` names the show-rules control the tray is (declared with its words in parts/ui/part.json `controls`, where every control is listed): hidden, the tray, its menu rows and its picking are not offered. `contexts` says where things are worked on: a thing picked inside a pane that holds one of these kinds (a pursuit, marked by main.tsx from surfaces.json opens_kinds) carries that place, so the tray offers that pursuit first and a note says which pursuit it came from.
